NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以加速计算平台为核心，整合硬件、软件、算法与服务，推动数据中心规模AI基础设施。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Accelerated computing platform integrating hardware, software, algorithms to power data center-scale AI.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 全栈式AI布局，以智能云与平台为核心，赋能生产力并强调责任与安全。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Full-stack AI across cloud and edge, empowering productivity with responsibility and security-first.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建将生成式AI与现有数据操作平台深度整合的企业AI平台，以实现AI驱动的决策优势。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Developing an integrated AI platform (AIP) combining generative AI with existing data operations for enterprise and government decision advantage.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将AI集成到社交、可穿戴及未来计算平台，打造智能助手与沉浸式体验。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrating AI across social apps, wearables, and future computing to build transformative experiences.
